title: Command Search (SettingsAndHelp)

scenarios.title: Command Search applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Command Search (BtnSearchBar) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: Search Enter priority ladder, tie-break and obsolete filtering pinned host-free
scenarios.expected: Enter runs the first sidebar search match, so the production ordering is the contract: for the query 'Anchor' the result order walks the complete scoring ladder - exact name/id (0), exact alias (1), name prefix (2), alias prefix (3), id prefix (4), name contains (5, ties broken by name ordinal-ignore-case), alias contains (6), id contains (7), description contains (8), help text contains (9) - case-insensitive throughout, obsolete records never enter the result, and an empty or whitespace query returns nothing so Enter cannot launch a command.
